name: NEWCHAE SHOT
tagline: A Masterpiece Built on Three Pillars

overview: NEWCHAE SHOT is a home-care beauty device integrating professional-grade medical technologies into a compact form factor with multi-channel energy delivery.
description: Three pillars of uncompromising engineering meet the pinnacle of beauty science. Born from TORR RF medical device heritage, NEWCHAE SHOT delivers professional-grade RF, EMS, and Electroporation in one device -- crafted for home care excellence.

specifications.label: Battery
specifications.note: Samsung SDI cell / USB-C charging / 5-6 uses per charge

differentiators.description: Built on the same multi-channel RF technology proven in BRITZMEDI's TORR RF medical device used in professional clinics.
Automatic shot system concentrates RF energy output for precise delivery at optimal intervals. Buzzer indicates completion per zone.
Electrodes made of medical-grade stainless steel (not plated). Samsung SDI battery cells with 3,350mAh high-capacity lithium-ion.
Max 8W RF power at 1 MHz with RF STACK method for deeper heat penetration without surface skin damage. Unmatched in home devices.
10,000 micro-vibrations per minute with different vibration patterns per mode for optimized energy penetration and comfortable treatment.
Manufactured by a domestic GMP-certified company. Certified with KC (Korea), CE (Europe), and VCCI (Japan) standards.

companionProduct.name: NEWCHAE Peptide Lifting Cream
companionProduct.description: Engineered to serve a dual purpose: maximize RF energy conductivity for optimal device performance, and simultaneously deliver a concentrated peptide complex that transforms each treatment session into a full skincare regimen.
